issue_context.title: reading from GCS parallelly is slow, the speed is about the same as reading serially.
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
reading from GCS parallelly is slow, the speed is about the same as reading serially.
after investigate, we found that http2 will reuse connection to send request, so parallelly readers is actually using 1 connection, we can enhance by set disable keep alive=true

see https://github.com/googleapis/google-cloud-go/issues/1514 too

review_comments:
not sure if it should be the default behaviour of Google clous storage  
cc @Leavrth @YuJuncen
I think it's OK because we don't have a high concurrency of Google cloud Storage objects accessing, and the socket/memory usage should be affordable.
